dropped.item: Closing at lease end means no early-termination penalties (a 'natural exit')
The window to decide is the next few months
If we wait, we risk being pulled into renewal terms by default
Mall traffic 'has been eroding' (past trend), and performance depends on mall health 'rather than our own brand pull'
Denver delivers the full brand experience; online reaches customers regardless of location
Specific mall-store cost drivers (rent, CAM charges, staffing, buildout upkeep) and that the stores spread management attention and cash thin
Consolidating lets us concentrate talent and inventory
Flexibility rationale: avoids locking in another multi-year commitment in a channel we're already questioning
Denver staffing is meant to capture customers from the closing stores
Online investment specifics: site performance, fulfillment speed, marketing, customer retention, and a focus on converting mall-store customers
Customer transition specifics: targeted outreach before closing, promotions, local-pickup or shipping incentives, invitation to Denver
Customer outreach to start at least six months before closing
Employee mitigation specifics: redeployment into Denver and online roles where possible, severance and transition support for others
Concentration risk defined as relying on one physical location and one digital channel
Concentration mitigation specifics: set clear performance thresholds and revisit pop-up or wholesale options
Inventory as part of the closing-cost risk, and a phased wind-down and liquidation as the mitigation
Breakdown of one-time closing costs (liquidation, severance, restoration)
Leadership named as the decision-maker in the final next step

changed.item: Original says renewal decisions and landlord negotiations typically start 9–12 months before expiration; edit says landlords want to start the renewal process then (shifts the actor to landlords)
Decision deadline: original says 'ahead of landlord notice deadlines'; edit says 'before they contact us', which drops the contractual notice-deadline framing
Original says 'structurally declining' (a characterization of an ongoing trend); edit says traffic 'is going to continue to go down', a firmer forecast
Original says 'stronger potential returns on incremental investment'; edit says 'where we can get a higher return', which drops the hedge
Original says a wind-down and liquidation starts in Q1 2027; edit says to have a plan 'starting in Q1 2027' to close the stores, making it ambiguous whether execution or planning starts then
Financial section reframed as 'dollars we will save', although it also covers closing costs, reinvestment, and payback

added.item: Finance named as a partner for the closing-cost mitigation plan
Mitigation framed as 'always have the ability to pivot if needed'
Implication that landlords will contact us (framing the deadline as preempting landlord outreach)
